thread:
alex (eng): FYI: Customer ACME asked for a full account deletion but Legal put a hold. Need advice on temporary access so we can validate what’s blocked.

maria (security): Do we have a playbook for "temporary erasure-grant"? I remember a runbook but not sure about audit hooks for KMS operations. :thinking_face: 

jamal (infra): We have a short-lived role we call `eraser-temp` that can be granted via privctl with TTL. It emits audit events to our central logging. Example: `privctl grant --subject=svc-acme-ops --role=eraser-temp --until=2024-06-05T18:00Z --ticket=INC-7012`

alex (eng): Perfect — two questions: 1) Does `eraser-temp` decrypt snapshots with the keystore? 2) If we grant it, will the delete be visible in the retention/erasure audit so Legal can confirm?

maria (security): 1) `eraser-temp` has KMS unwrap permissions only when the keystore flag `allow-temporary-unwrap` is set for the grant. By default it does NOT allow snapshot decryption. We should avoid enabling unwrap unless Legal explicitly approves.

sara (legal): We need a clear evidence trail. If you enable decryption, capture: requestor identity, ticket ID, justification, exact object IDs, timestamps, and a signed attestation from the engineer performing the operation. Otherwise, we can review metadata-only evidence (delete markers, object manifest).

jamal (infra): Noted. We can enable metadata-only erasures without KMS unwrap: that will mark vectors and snapshots as deleted and trigger async scrub. Audit log entries will include `privctl` grant id and `eraser` job id.

alex (eng): There's an extra wrinkle: the customer asked for EU-only deletion. Our snapshots are cross-region (eu-west-1 + us-east-1). If we perform metadata-only delete in EU, how quickly does propagation to US happen?

maria (security): Propagation is eventual. For EU-scoped delete we have a propagation job that runs hourly. If Legal wants hard EU-only removal, we need to isolate and create a retention-exception so downstream replication to US is blocked. That requires SRE + Compliance signoff.

sara (legal): Approve metadata-only EU delete for now, but no KMS unwrap or cross-region replication until we confirm requestor identity. Please raise retention-exception request with the form (PrivPath case) and include ticket INC-7012.

jamal (infra): OK — I'll file the retention-exception. Quick status: `privctl request-retention-exception --scope=eu --ticket=INC-7012 --reason="pending identity verification"` will create the case and set a hold tag.

alex (eng): Can someone confirm what audit entries we'll get so I can save screenshots for the customer?

maria (security): You will see: `privctl grant.<id>` (who/when/ttl), `eraser.job.<id>` (object IDs, partitions touched), `kms.request.<id>` only if unwrap performed. All go to `audit.redwood.sec` and are immutable for 90 days. Also copies to Legal's WORM bucket for 1 year.

alex (eng): Great. I'll proceed with metadata-only EU delete once the retention-exception case is open and signoff is attached. Taking action item: open case and request SRE pause on replication.

jamal (infra): Action: I created the PrivPath case PRV-2439 and set `hold=TRUE`. Also applied a temporary policy to block EU->US replication for ACME dataset. Command run: `repctl block --dataset=acme-prod --from=eu-west-1 --to=us-east-1 --ticket=PRV-2439`. :white_check_mark:

alex (eng): Nice. I'll run the metadata delete now and paste the eraser job id here once it starts.

deploy-bot: eraser.job.70012001 started by alex (eng) via privctl (grant: 7012345699) — scanning 3 partitions — estimated 4m.

alex (eng): eraser.job.70012001: scanned, marked manifests+vector-index as deleted in eu-west-1. No KMS unwrap performed. Screenshot attached to PRV-2439 (link).

sara (legal): Received. Waiting on requester identity verification. If identity is confirmed, we may need to enable targeted unwrap to prove content-level deletion for specific records — will update PRV-2439.

maria (security): Small vuln-triage note: while blocking replication, watch for backfill jobs that might pick up stale S3 object copies. I opened a vuln tag VULN-9802 to ensure we don't accidentally rehydrate deleted content during backfill.

alex (eng): Thanks. Any final asks before I close the thread?

sara (legal): Keep all audit links and attestation in PRV-2439. If identity check fails, we'll escalate to retention exception denial and preserve data as-is.

maria (security): I'll follow-up with an automated audit snapshot and put the event ids in the case.

alex (eng): Closing on my side. Tagging @sara (legal) for final signoff when identity check completes. :thumbsup:
